project_type: Node.js Express CRM with Socket.IO, monolithic server.js, multi-panel HTML (admin/agent/tl)
build_system: npm, no build step - server.js is the single entry point
test_framework: None - no test files exist. Validation is done by running the server.
build_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node -e "require('./server.js')" (server starts and listens, ctrl+c to stop)
test_command: No test suite. Verify by syntax check: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check server.js
verification_instructions: 1. Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check server.js` to verify no syntax errors. 2. Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check public/forms/PLJOB-main/lead-shared.js` to verify shared JS. 3. Verify HTML files parse correctly.
setup_instructions: npm install (but npm registry is blocked in this sandbox - all deps already in node_modules)
environment_constraints: npm registry is 403 forbidden - cannot install new packages. ffprobe/ffmpeg not available. Must use pure Node.js for audio duration parsing. Use `unset NODE_OPTIONS` before running node commands.
contribution_requirements: Commit on a new branch created from origin/main. Do NOT push.
key_patterns: Single server.js (~3900 lines) with Express routes. HTML panels in public/admin/index.html, public/tl/index.html, public/agent/index.html. Forms in public/forms/PLJOB-main/. State stored in appState object with JSON persistence.
relevant_files: server.js (lines 1200-1310 for LABEL_TO_FIELD mapping, lines 3760-3860 for recordings API)
directory_structure: Root: server.js, package.json. public/admin/index.html, public/tl/index.html, public/agent/index.html. public/forms/PLJOB-main/ has 5 form HTMLs + lead-shared.js. Data stored externally in DATA_ROOT.
